profile.constituencyprofile_Text: The Mummidivaram Assembly Constituency Vision Action Plan 2024-29 has been meticulously designed to leverage the constituency's agricultural strength, dynamic industrial base, thriving construction sector, and robust service sector. This strategic blueprint aligns with Andhra Pradesh’s ambitious Swarna Andhra@2047 vision, which resonates with the national agenda of Viksit Bharat@2047. These are located in the Konaseema district of Andhra Pradesh, with Mummidivaram serving as the headquarters. The name Mummidivaram is derived from the ancient name “MUNIVARAM” (“Blessings of Rishis & Saints”). In the early days the sages, saints used to perform tapsya (Penance) in this region and stands as a holy place. Mummidivaram Mandal is an earst while Taluka of Amalapuram Division, later days it becomes constituency Head Quarter Mummidivaram Mandal was separated as Rural and Urban in the year of 2014 Mummidivaram is located on NH 216 and is about 13 Km from District HQ, as well as Divisional HQ, Amalapuram. economy_text.economy_Text:
Mummidivaram’s Economy at a Glance


The Economic Vision Plan for Mummidivaram lays a structured path for accelerating economic growth, boosting employment, and ensuring inclusive development. With a Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) of ₹10,840 crores in 2023-24, Mummidivaram is projected to expand steadily, reaching ₹24216 crores by 2028-29, marking a significant transformation across agriculture, industry, and services sectors. The industrial sector accounts for 44.70%, agriculture and allied activities contribute 36.19% and service sector contributes 19.11%.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Mummidivaram is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like Fishing & Aquaculture ,Mining & Quarrying , Manufacturing and livestock. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant urban and economic hub by 2047.
